title: Audit: which CI jobs and steps check what a lane agent or the lane lint already checks (speed)
why:

Triage's earlier-answer search (read-only Explore, 11:19 CST, triage's own read): NO earlier answer found. The owner's phrase is in no searched source: roadmap rulings, steps, plans and briefs; the 51 open page items; the 862 closed items from the 17:04 dump; docs/decisions; docs/plans; skill ci-hygiene. Nearest, none answering it: decision lanes-run-no-full-ci-job (lanes run the lint locally, set after incidents, not for speed); decision ci-cut-in-steps (owner pick e, Oct 27: full suite on main, quick checks per branch); rulings own-batch-runner-scales and own-rolling-combine-train; plan docs/plans/test-ci-standard.md line 20 (a named local check with a recorded run can replace CI); skill ci-hygiene SKILL.md lines 194-201 (speed steps keep checks in CI). CLAUDE.md rule roles-each-layer-proves-once makes CI the merge check, so moving checks out of CI would rewrite it (the owner's grant is needed for that rewrite).

Lane (coordinator 11:25 CST, relayed; not read by triage): no session. It is the coordinator's own Explore agent, agent id a511629e8439eaf22, running (Opus, `Audit:` first line, read-only), report cap 60 lines, not yet back. It reads which CI jobs and steps judge what a lane agent or the lane lint already judges, with minutes from the last 5 runs, and gives each cut with a refusing check. No size or saving claimed: unmeasured.

FINDINGS IN 11:29 CST Nov 15 (coordinator's Explore agent a511629e8439eaf22, Opus, read-only; relayed, not read by triage; sums over n=5 ready PR runs and n=5 main push runs, step sums n=4 on push). (1) The only steps that could move to agents are about 25 lane-lint check steps in job `checks`: 4.8 min per PR run, 4.0 per push. Every cut is blocked by own-mechanical-before-cleanup: merge.py:lint_check (the refusing check) runs only on a cloud confirm and returns early when the rollup is green (merge.py:4961, ruling own-lint-skip-green-rollup-a), so nothing would refuse a merge where the lane lint did not run. (2) The `checks` job is not the critical path; Windows guard 22 to 29 min and shell-macos 29 to 40 min are. A cut saves about 1 runner-minute per run, no wall time. Windows 13 jobs sum 1150 min per PR run, macOS 220, other checks jobs 318, mutation 123. (3) Outside the brief: 4 of the last 5 main push runs ran in full, 30 to 45 min each; push-skip logged only `skip=false`. The coordinator started lane push-skip-reads-why (its pick, undoable; step push-skip-reads-why). (4) Not started, with reason: a lane making lint_check refuse a missing lane-lint PASS on every machine (gain about 1 runner-minute per run; moves a guard's verdict). (5) Could not read: why push-skip did not skip; step minutes in the other jobs; child-repo action minutes; lane-lint time on the lane's machine. (6) Question for the owner, which rule text governs the cut list: A) main's text 'the PR run is the merge check': nothing is a cut candidate (coordinator's recommendation, gain small); B) the carve-out that CI keeps only full suites and mutation tests: row 1 steps are candidates. No owner question will be asked (consultant's pick, 11:33 CST Nov 15, relayed, not read by triage: it dropped the question and keeps main's text, the PR run is the merge check, which restates main; nothing is cut).

11:33 CST Nov 15 (consultant, relayed by the coordinator at 11:34; not read by triage): the consultant dropped the CI-to-agents question. Main's text stands: the PR run is the merge check; nothing cut. The finding stays here: about 1 runner-minute per run, no wall-time saving; the wall time is in Windows guard 22 to 29 min and shell-macos 29 to 40 min.
